campos.Message:
Hi Glinda Games team,

I am writing about the 3D Artist role on the art team. I am a Senior 3D Character Artist with more than ten years in stylized work, and the range you describe is the range I actually work in: environment props and set dressing, vehicles and signage, and occasional character or creature work.

What I do end to end is the asset itself. At E-Line Media in Arizona I have spent almost five years taking Endstar's hero assets from first sculpt to engine: sculpt, retopology, UVs, baking, PBR texturing, trim sheets, material work, look development and engine integration, including polish and optimization passes. Before that I modeled and hand-painted the characters for The Wingfeather Saga season 1 at Angel Studios, and before that I spent three years at PUGA Studios delivering assets under another studio's art direction in the client's defined style, with revision rounds as routine. Your line about being grounded in realistic PBR while also exploring stylised directions is exactly the ground I stand on.

Tools: ZBrush, Substance Painter and Designer, Maya, Marmoset, Houdini for grooming, Unity and Unreal for integration.

Two honest notes. First, your ad asks for two to four years and I have more than ten, so if you are building a mid-level seat I would rather you know that up front than find out on the call. I am not looking to lead this one, I am looking to build assets and to be useful from week one. Second, I am not an Australian citizen or permanent resident, so I would need visa sponsorship. I want to relocate and I am fully open to moving for the role, and my academic background, with an honors laurea, a postgraduate specialization in Game Art, a master's in progress, IELTS and publications, makes a strong visa case.

My portfolio holds more than 45 projects with over 60 characters across many titles, and my personal projects are some of the strongest pieces in it.

Portfolio: artstation.com/viniciuscavalcanti
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/vinicavalcnti

Thank you for your time.

Vini Cavalcanti
